I saw the first episode. I enjoyed it. I was expecting the main character to be a suave White Collar-esque guy, but he wasn't, and I liked that. Not knowing what is real is fun in a show.

Some of the technology conversations are odd and forced (a discussion of KDE vs GNOME, for instance), but if you can look past that, the show was interesting. I don't know where they plan to go with the rest of the series, though. What happened at the ending happened much earlier than I would have expected, so I don't know what they plan for the next episodes. I'd be disappointed if it turned into a case of the week thing, but it's possible.

Some of the technology conversations are odd and forced

The pilot and series certainly look interesting thus far, though it would be a large stretch to call this a realistic portrayal.

The first two eps are great and the teaser for the third makes me hyped for the rest of the show.
